page.content:
2005–08 Nickelodeon series of three books: Water, Earth, Fire.

How Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) connects

  • Topic: Avatar: The Last Airbender — The 2005 series is the core Avatar: The Last Airbender work.
  • Character: Aang — The original series is Aang's story as the last airbender.
  • Creator: Michael Dante DiMartino — DiMartino showran the original series.
  • Creator: Bryan Konietzko — Konietzko shaped the original series' world and look.
  • Faction: The Gaang — The series is the Gaang's journey across the four nations.
  • Event: Sozin's Comet — The series races toward Sozin's Comet.
  • Series: The Legend of Korra — The Legend of Korra follows seventy years after Aang's war.
  • Event: Sozin's Comet — The series climax is timed to Sozin's Comet.

What is Avatar: The Last Airbender (series)?

The original series follows Aang's awakening, the Gaang's training through the Water Tribes and Earth Kingdom, and the comet-deadline fight with Ozai.

Key threads lead to Avatar: The Last Airbender, Aang, Michael Dante DiMartino, Bryan Konietzko, The Gaang and Sozin's Comet.
